title: Éter Anima — abertura de Stone Reach
statusNote: Roteiro e referências preparados. Este documento não comprova geração de clips, revisão anatômica final, integração nem exportação do vídeo.

generationPlan.note: Five seconds describes each principal action. Final editorial budgets include six seconds for shot 01 and six and a half seconds for shot 12. Actual tool durations and final timing must be recorded after generation; do not claim 1500 independently hand-drawn/generated images.
generationPlan.titlePresentation: DOM overlay after export; no baked text in generated key art or video.
generationPlan.finalCastAssembly: Reuse approved individual shots through editing/montage; do not generate all 15 figures simultaneously.

artDirection.finish: Crisp fine ink contours, controlled 2–3 tone cel shading, mature heroes, canonical chibi companions, refined costume details.
artDirection.references: Established Seiji, Ophelia, Carmilla, Ava and Orfeu art; Mushoku Tensei and Fate Series are the repository's visual direction references.
artDirection.anatomy: Two arms, two legs per human; coherent joints, wrists and hands; no extra limb. Shin must have exactly two distinct legs and boots. Dante has two avian legs.
artDirection.motion: Gentle camera, single physically plausible action per hero shot; no bright flashes/strobes, excessive shake or sudden white-out.
artDirection.elements: Ava earth; Ophelia ice/healing; Seiji ink; Marin darkness; Gabriel fire; Max electricity and iron nails; Carmilla blood/threads; Beatriz water and darkness; Abel primordial fire/lion; Orfeu neutral physical anti-magic.

loreGuardrails.openingContext: A quiet academy conceals an unexplained noise. Beatriz asks the party to investigate a record in the archive.
loreGuardrails.allowed: Suggest stone vibration, erased writing, curiosity, care, solidarity and the desire to remember.
loreGuardrails.excluded: Do not reveal the sealed stair's destination, the Selo resolution, final enemy identity, quest endings or long-quest memory revelations.
loreGuardrails.teachers: Ava, Orfeu, Beatriz, Abel and Carmilla receive no invented companions.
loreGuardrails.rosterNote: Abel is currently an exploration/workshop NPC, separate from the nine playable heroes. Presenting him here does not change gameplay or recruitment.
loreGuardrails.marinNote: Use the approved v29 adult androgynous male visual identity. Legacy feminine text is inconsistent and must not silently change his approved body design.

identities.name: Seiji
identities.identityEn: Adult lean male calligraphy swordsman; long silver-white hair with thin red ribbons, red eyes, ivory Japanese haori with red lining and red emblems over a layered black robe, red sash and tassels, black boots, sheathed katana and a black/gold calligraphy brush. Ink is black/navy with ivory paper talismans, never flames.

identities.name: Ophelia
identities.identityEn: Elegant adult female ice healer; violet eyes, long black hair with violet ends and straight bangs, ornate gold monocle on her left eye, white lace veil/headdress with violet roses and pearls, ornate violet/lavender gothic dress and purple boots. Preserve purple costume; ice and healing use translucent blue-white snowflakes/crystals, never fire.

identities.name: Marin
identities.identityEn: Adult slender androgynous male; wavy layered black hair, grey-blue eyes, blue dangling earring, black noble long coat with gold embroidery and blue lining, blue waistcoat, white high collar and full white sleeves, gold chains, fitted black trousers and boots. Exactly two curved violet-black daggers, one per hand. Darkness is violet/near-black.

identities.name: Gabriel
identities.identityEn: Adult athletic male; short spiky white hair, amber eyes, warm skin, fitted black/gold long coat with crimson lining and orange flame-like collar, white open-collar shirt, belts and gold chains with red gems, dark trousers, black tall boots and gloves. Unarmed fire fists; no sword. Keep human form in this opening shot.

identities.name: Max
identities.identityEn: Adult slender lanky male; pale stitched skin, short tousled black hair, amber eyes, black hooded coat with orange lining/stitches, distressed off-white shirt, dark fitted trousers, chains and black boots/gloves. Iron nails have broad flat round heads and pointed shafts. Yellow/cyan electric arcs. Preserve the small black orange-eyed shoulder rodent as a costume detail; it is not Vajra.

identities.name: Ava Rosa Groot
identities.identityEn: Athletic adult female earth martial artist; long auburn wavy hair with tiny white/pink flowers, green eyes, olive-green sleeveless cross-wrap crop top, long deep-green sash, loose ivory trousers, white forearm wraps and green crisscross shoes. Grounded unarmed martial movement. Earth is layered ochre sandstone/granite, restrained mineral dust and gold mineral glints. Floral costume details are decorative, not plant attacks.

identities.name: Orfeu Bauss
identities.identityEn: Adult athletic/slender brown-skinned martial artist man; medium-short tousled silver-white hair, dark focused eyes, black sleeveless Chinese-collar vest with fine gold fasteners/trim, narrow black/gold upper-arm bands, white wrist/palm/forearm wraps with naturally bare fingers, asymmetric deep-blue embroidered waist sash, loose dark trousers and low navy/gold martial shoes. Unarmed physical anti-magic: slate-grey/white pressure, dark fractures and dust. Ignore the old portrait's blue/gold magical rings; use the v25 combat costume and current v30 neutral-effects direction.

identities.name: Carmilla
identities.identityEn: Elegant tall adult female vampire professor; long straight blonde hair below hips, subtle pointed ears, ruby-red eyes, black high-collar academic robe with wine-red lining and gold stitch/web filigree, ruby jewelry, fitted black dress and tall laced boots. Exactly two dark-metal sewing needles with ruby grips, carmine threads and small red droplets. No gore.

identities.name: Beatriz Demeter
identities.identityEn: Adult black-haired violet-eyed witch sword professor; large black witch hat with gold/purple clasp, white high-collar academic coat with gold trim and dark-blue lining, white gloves, black belt with potion vials and white strapped boots. One slim straight pale-blue sword with gold/purple hilt. Water is blue fluid ribbon; darkness is a separate near-black/violet wisp, not ice.

identities.name: Abel Nomikos
identities.role: Professor da Forja Antiga; visitante NPC
identities.identityEn: Adult medium-brown-skinned male professor; short wavy ginger-red hair, narrow round gold-rim glasses, crimson hooded academic cloak with gold embroidery, tailored black high-collar outfit, dark gold-trimmed boots, belts/chain and dark gold-trimmed waist book.
